rules.statement: A Kandyan deed of gift, intended by the donor to operate as a donation and accepted by the donee as such, is revocable unless it contains specific clauses making it irrevocable.
rules.supporting_quote: "That being the law, it must, I think, in all cases be followed, except in a case to the special circumstances of which it is quite manifest that it was not intended to apply in all its rigour."
